metadata.name: anyfee
metadata.description: anyfee: tips and fee routing to GitHub repos, GitHub users and X accounts, keyed by numeric id

instructions.name: bind
docs: Binds (or requests a rebind of) a vault to `claimant`. Requires the immediately
preceding instruction to be an Ed25519SigVerify of `M` by `config.attester`.

instructions.name: cancel_rebind
docs: Current claimant clears a pending rebind.

instructions.name: claim_sol
docs: Current claimant withdraws all lamports above rent (minus outstanding tips if declined).

instructions.name: claim_token
docs: Current claimant withdraws the vault ATA balance (minus outstanding tips if declined).

accounts.name: destination
docs: Any token account for `config.usdc_mint`, chosen by the claimant.

instructions.name: close_tip
docs: Permissionless crank: closes a tip receipt consumed by a claim; rent back to its sender.

instructions.name: decline
docs: Current claimant declines: no new tips, outstanding tips refundable immediately.

instructions.name: finalize_rebind
docs: Permissionless once the rebind delay has passed.

instructions.name: init_vault
docs: Permissionless; the payer funds rent. Works on an address that already holds lamports.

accounts.name: vault
docs: Anchor's `init` handles an address that already holds lamports (routed fees sent
before initialization): it tops up to rent exemption, then allocates and assigns
with the PDA signature. Pre-existing lamports stay in the vault and are claimable.

instructions.name: initialize
docs: One-time setup. The signer must be the program's upgrade authority and becomes admin.

accounts.name: admin
docs: Becomes `config.admin`. Must be the program's upgrade authority, so nobody can
front-run initialization between deploy and initialize.

instructions.name: refund_tip
docs: Permissionless crank: refunds a SOL tip to its sender when the refund rules allow it.

accounts.name: tip
docs: Closed on success; its rent goes back to the sender.

instructions.name: refund_tip_token
docs: Permissionless crank: refunds a token tip to its sender's ATA when the rules allow it.

accounts.name: tip
docs: Closed on success; its rent goes back to the sender.

accounts.name: sender_token_account
docs: The sender's associated token account for `config.usdc_mint`. If the sender closed it,
the cranker can recreate it first (ATA `create_idempotent`) in the same transaction.

instructions.name: set_config
docs: Admin only. `None` keeps a value. Cannot touch vault funds or `usdc_mint`.

instructions.name: tip_sol
docs: Direct SOL tip with a refundable receipt. The vault must exist.

accounts.name: vault
docs: Must already be initialized (prepend `init_vault` if it is not).

instructions.name: tip_token
docs: Direct `config.usdc_mint` tip into the vault's ATA (created if missing). The vault must exist.

accounts.name: vault
docs: Must already be initialized (prepend `init_vault` if it is not).

accounts.name: vault_token_account
docs: The vault's associated token account for `config.usdc_mint`; created if missing.

errors.name: VaultDeclined
errors.msg: Vault has been declined by its claimant; it accepts no new tips

errors.name: Paused
errors.msg: Program is paused (tips, binds and rebind finalization are disabled)

errors.name: NotClaimant
errors.msg: Signer is not the vault's claimant

errors.name: BadAttestation
errors.msg: Attestation message does not match the expected bind message

errors.name: AttestationExpired
errors.msg: Attestation has expired

errors.name: RebindNotReady
errors.msg: Pending rebind is not effective yet

errors.name: NothingToClaim
errors.msg: Nothing to claim

errors.name: RefundNotYet
errors.msg: Tip is not refundable yet

errors.name: TipAlreadySettled
errors.msg: Tip was already refunded or consumed by a claim

errors.name: UnknownPlatform
errors.msg: Unknown platform

errors.name: VaultUnbound
errors.msg: Vault is not bound to a claimant

errors.name: NoPendingRebind
errors.msg: Vault has no pending rebind

errors.name: AlreadyClaimant
errors.msg: Claimant is already bound to this vault

errors.name: AlreadyDeclined
errors.msg: Vault is already declined

errors.name: InvalidClaimant
errors.msg: Invalid claimant

errors.name: ZeroAmount
errors.msg: Amount must be greater than zero

errors.name: MathOverflow
errors.msg: Arithmetic overflow

errors.name: InvalidConfig
errors.msg: Configuration value out of bounds

errors.name: NotAdmin
errors.msg: Signer is not the admin

errors.name: NotUpgradeAuthority
errors.msg: Signer is not the program's upgrade authority

errors.name: MissingEd25519Instruction
errors.msg: The instruction before bind must be an Ed25519SigVerify instruction

errors.name: MalformedEd25519Instruction
errors.msg: Malformed Ed25519SigVerify instruction (need exactly one signature, all offsets inside the same instruction)

errors.name: WrongAttester
errors.msg: Attestation was not signed by the configured attester

errors.name: NotRefundable
errors.msg: Tip is not refundable: the vault is bound and not declined

errors.name: WrongTipKind
errors.msg: Wrong refund instruction for this tip's asset (use refund_tip for SOL, refund_tip_token for tokens)

errors.name: TipNotConsumed
errors.msg: Tip has not been consumed by a claim

errors.name: InvalidDestination
errors.msg: Invalid destination

errors.name: InsufficientVaultBalance
errors.msg: Vault balance is below its reserved amount

fields.name: mint
docs: `Pubkey::default()` = SOL.

fields.name: consumed_tips
docs: True when this claim consumed the epoch's tips (claim_epoch was incremented).

types.name: Config
docs: Global configuration. PDA seeds: `["config"]`.

fields.name: admin
docs: May change attester, windows, pause flag and admin. Can never move vault funds.

fields.name: attester
docs: ed25519 key whose signature over the bind message `M` authorises `bind`.

fields.name: usdc_mint
docs: The only SPL mint accepted by `tip_token` / `claim_token` / `refund_tip_token`.

fields.name: refund_window_secs
docs: An unbound vault's direct tips become refundable this long after they were sent.

fields.name: rebind_delay_secs
docs: Delay between a rebind request and when it can be finalized.

fields.name: paused
docs: Blocks new tips, binds and rebind finalization. Never blocks claims, refunds,
cancel_rebind or decline.

fields.name: mint
docs: `Pubkey::default()` = SOL.

types.name: Tip
docs: Receipt for one direct tip. PDA seeds: `["tip", vault, tip_index.to_le_bytes()]`.

fields.name: mint
docs: `Pubkey::default()` = SOL; otherwise `config.usdc_mint`.

fields.name: mint
docs: `Pubkey::default()` = SOL.

types.name: Vault
docs: One vault per (platform, id). PDA seeds: `["vault", [platform], id.to_le_bytes()]`.
The address is deterministic and can receive lamports (and, through its associated
token account, tokens) before the account is initialized.

fields.name: claimant
docs: `Pubkey::default()` = unbound.

fields.name: pending_claimant
docs: `Pubkey::default()` = no pending rebind.

fields.name: claim_epoch
docs: +1 on every claim that consumes tips; tips from an older epoch can no longer be refunded.

fields.name: tip_count
docs: Number of tips ever received; the next tip's index.

fields.name: outstanding_tip_lamports
docs: Lamports of receipted tips of the current epoch that are not refunded yet.

fields.name: outstanding_tip_tokens
docs: Token base units of receipted tips of the current epoch that are not refunded yet.

fields.name: prefunded_lamports
docs: Lamports above rent exemption right after initialization, i.e. routed fees that
reached the address before it was initialized (0 for a fresh address).

constants.name: BIND_DOMAIN
docs: Domain separator at the start of the attestation message `M`.

constants.name: BIND_MESSAGE_LEN
docs: `M` = domain (14) || program_id (32) || platform (1) || id u64 LE (8) || claimant (32) || expires_at i64 LE (8).

constants.name: MAX_REBIND_DELAY_SECS
docs: Upper bound for `rebind_delay_secs` (30 days).

constants.name: MAX_REFUND_WINDOW_SECS
docs: Upper bound for `refund_window_secs` (365 days): sender funds are never locked indefinitely.

constants.name: MIN_REBIND_DELAY_SECS
docs: Lower bound for `rebind_delay_secs` (1 day): a claimant always has at least a day to cancel
a rebind requested by a compromised attester.

constants.name: MIN_REFUND_WINDOW_SECS
docs: Lower bound for `refund_window_secs` (1 day): tips cannot be bounced before a recipient can react.
